sample_features_at_coords: sample features from a feature map at normalized point coordinates using bilinear interpolation
generate_regular_grid_coords: generate a regular square grid of normalized point coordinates for a given number of regions
sample_uncertain_points_with_randomness: sample uncertain points from coarse logits using importance sampling combined with random sampling
find_uncertain_points_on_grid: find the most uncertain points from an uncertainty map on a regular grid
sample_point_labels_from_masks: sample ground truth point labels from BitMasks given absolute image pixel coordinates
